citation: Ford Motor Credit Co. v. Milhollin, 444 U.S. 555 (1980)
court: Supreme Court of the United States
statute_version_applicable: 15 U.S.C. §1638 + Federal Reserve Board Regulation Z (pre-Dodd-Frank version)
rule_established: Deference to Federal Reserve Board (now CFPB) Regulation Z interpretations; Official Staff Commentary is authoritative; purpose of TILA (comparison shopping) informs disclosure requirement interpretation; good faith reliance on official guidance is relevant to liability
post_loper_bright_note: Milhollin's deference holding weakened by Loper Bright Enterprises v. Raimondo (U.S. 2024) overruling Chevron; Official Staff Commentary to Regulation Z remains persuasive authority but mandatory deference reduced
verification_note: Verify 444 U.S. 555 citation; note post-Loper Bright deference landscape when citing for agency deference proposition
